name: Cascade Failure
description: Eight crew members, dual saboteurs who don't know about each other, eleven locations, hidden forensic evidence, and a scarce fabrication economy for diagnosis, recovery, coordination, or deception.
notes: Designed for larger models. Information asymmetry is central: different investigators start near different evidence, material stacks, and fabrication facilities. Resource conflicts make it impossible to craft every diagnostic, recovery, coordination, and deception tool.
